starters.title: Refresh an existing website
starters.goal: Refresh this website while preserving its brand, content and existing framework.
starters.whenToUse: When you have an existing interface or a concrete design brief.
starters.prompt: Use $dazzler-frontend to refresh this website while preserving its brand, content and existing framework.
starters.advanced: Optional: specify audience, required brand values, target format and constraints. Leave visual choices to Dazzler unless you want control. If you supply a Figma frame, use available authorized read tools and preserve existing project tokens; otherwise use your supplied export and label the evidence gap.
starters.exercises: Preserve the brand, establish a primary action, check narrow reflow and keyboard focus, and save accepted decisions.
starters.expect: A working refresh with narrow/wide previews and a short change summary.
starters.tips: Review the existing tokens and primary user journey before changing code.
outputs: A working refresh with narrow/wide previews and a short change summary.
limitations: Review the existing tokens and primary user journey before changing code.

starters.title: Give a landing page stronger contrast
starters.goal: Make this landing page more vivid and readable, keeping its message and main action.
starters.whenToUse: When you have an existing interface or a concrete design brief.
starters.prompt: Use $dazzler-frontend to make this landing page more vivid and readable, keeping its message and main action.
starters.advanced: Optional: specify audience, required brand values, target format and constraints. Leave visual choices to Dazzler unless you want control. Ask for a visual comp first only if you want one. Image generation depends on the host; a static proposal must still become real text and controls with rendered checks.
starters.exercises: Match the audience and stakes, make the main action clear, and inspect error recovery and keyboard controls.
starters.expect: A coherent palette, clearer type hierarchy and measured foreground/background pairs.
starters.tips: Preserve required brand colors; report conflicts instead of silently replacing them.
outputs: A coherent palette, clearer type hierarchy and measured foreground/background pairs.
limitations: Preserve required brand colors; report conflicts instead of silently replacing them.

starters.title: Compare a redesign proposal
starters.goal: Show a before-and-after redesign proposal for this page without changing the original.
starters.whenToUse: When you have an existing interface or a concrete design brief.
starters.prompt: Use $dazzler-frontend to show a before-and-after redesign proposal for this page without changing the original.
starters.advanced: Optional: specify audience, required brand values, target format and constraints. Leave visual choices to Dazzler unless you want control.
starters.exercises: Check the supplied evidence, choose a suitable visual direction, implement within the authorized scope, and inspect the result.
starters.expect: Separate proposal files, comparison images and the reasons for each major change.
starters.tips: Keep the original read-only; apply the proposal only when requested.
outputs: Separate proposal files, comparison images and the reasons for each major change.
limitations: Keep the original read-only; apply the proposal only when requested.

starters.title: Integrate Tailwind tokens

starters.exercises: Check the supplied evidence, choose a suitable visual direction, implement within the authorized scope, and inspect the result.
starters.expect: Version-appropriate theme mapping and a rendered component check.
starters.tips: Inspect Tailwind version and existing configuration; merge rather than replace it.
outputs: Version-appropriate theme mapping and a rendered component check.

starters.title: Redesign a Word report
starters.goal: Make this Word report polished and easier to read while preserving every fact and document object.
starters.whenToUse: When you have a document or verified notes to improve.
starters.prompt: Use $dazzler-frontend to make this Word report polished and easier to read while preserving every fact and document object.
starters.advanced: Optional: specify audience, required brand values, target format and constraints. Leave visual choices to Dazzler unless you want control.
starters.exercises: Check reading measure, heading hierarchy, selective emphasis, font coverage and every printed page.
starters.expect: A revised DOCX plus page-by-page render checks and any preservation limitations.
starters.tips: Use host document tools for existing files; the basic content exporter cannot preserve arbitrary objects.
outputs: A revised DOCX plus page-by-page render checks and any preservation limitations.
limitations: Use host document tools for existing files; the basic content exporter cannot preserve arbitrary objects.

starters.title: Improve a resume

starters.advanced: Optional: specify audience, required brand values, target format and constraints. Leave visual choices to Dazzler unless you want control.
starters.exercises: Check the supplied evidence, choose a suitable visual direction, implement within the authorized scope, and inspect the result.
starters.expect: A readable resume with consistent dates, hierarchy and checked pagination.
starters.tips: Aim for one page only if the supplied content fits; do not claim ATS certification.
outputs: A readable resume with consistent dates, hierarchy and checked pagination.
limitations: Aim for one page only if the supplied content fits; do not claim ATS certification.

starters.title: Write a one-page decision brief

starters.title: Restyle an existing deck
starters.goal: Restyle this presentation as a coherent branded deck while preserving its content and editable objects.

starters.advanced: Optional: specify audience, required brand values, target format and constraints. Leave visual choices to Dazzler unless you want control.
starters.exercises: Check the supplied evidence, choose a suitable visual direction, implement within the authorized scope, and inspect the result.
starters.expect: A revised native deck and a visual review of every slide.
starters.tips: Use host presentation tools; the content exporter is not a lossless PPTX editor.
outputs: A revised native deck and a visual review of every slide.
limitations: Use host presentation tools; the content exporter is not a lossless PPTX editor.

starters.title: Build a decision deck with a chart
starters.goal: Make a concise decision presentation from these facts and data, with an editable chart if supported.
starters.whenToUse: When you have presentation content or an existing deck.
starters.prompt: Use $dazzler-frontend to make a concise decision presentation from these facts and data, with an editable chart if supported.
starters.advanced: Optional: specify audience, required brand values, target format and constraints. Leave visual choices to Dazzler unless you want control.
starters.exercises: Check the supplied evidence, choose a suitable visual direction, implement within the authorized scope, and inspect the result.
starters.expect: A decision-led deck, chart source data and explicit editable/static status.
starters.tips: Native charts require R, mschart and officer; label SVG/HTML fallback as static.
outputs: A decision-led deck, chart source data and explicit editable/static status.
limitations: Native charts require R, mschart and officer; label SVG/HTML fallback as static.

starters.title: Explain a CSV with charts
starters.goal: Turn this CSV into a clear branded set of charts with labels, units and a data table.
starters.whenToUse: When you have actual data and a clear audience.
starters.prompt: Use $dazzler-frontend to turn this CSV into a clear branded set of charts with labels, units and a data table.
starters.advanced: Optional: specify audience, required brand values, target format and constraints. Leave visual choices to Dazzler unless you want control.
starters.exercises: Preserve source values and units, choose the chart for the analytical relationship, check contrast and provide non-color cues.
starters.expect: Charts grounded in supplied rows, accessible equivalents and stated missing-value handling.
starters.tips: Do not invent observations or describe CSV visualization as Excel workbook editing.
outputs: Charts grounded in supplied rows, accessible equivalents and stated missing-value handling.
limitations: Do not invent observations or describe CSV visualization as Excel workbook editing.

starters.title: Add a React sparkline

starters.prompt: Use $dazzler-frontend to add a compact, readable sparkline for this complete data series in the existing React UI.

starters.exercises: Check the supplied evidence, choose a suitable visual direction, implement within the authorized scope, and inspect the result.
starters.expect: An integrated React component with trend context and a text equivalent.
starters.tips: Use the current React runtime; handle incomplete or unsupported series through another chart route.
outputs: An integrated React component with trend context and a text equivalent.
limitations: Use the current React runtime; handle incomplete or unsupported series through another chart route.

starters.title: Extract a brand system
starters.goal: Derive a usable design system from this existing site and its brand files.

starters.exercises: Separate brand seeds from accessible roles, verify licensed font coverage, and record reusable decisions.

starters.tips: Observed frequency is evidence, not permission to lock a brand value.
outputs: Traceable observations, resolved tokens and visible conflicts.
limitations: Observed frequency is evidence, not permission to lock a brand value.
